name: The Beech Hangar
note: A hollow way sunk between banks under old beeches, the leaf litter copper over the whole ridge. The turned earth in the path is boar work, the holes under the roots are badgers, and by night Old Grist stands in the shade on the right.

markers.label: chanterelles at the roots
markers.note: two of them, and the first thing worth picking

markers.label: wild garlic on the bank
markers.note: two of it, under the fallen beech
